blocks.name: Core Courses-54 hours (Credits listed are in hours)

notes: The catalog prints course codes without a space (e.g., ACDVB70AN); these match the closed-list codes (e.g., ACDV B70AN), so they are not marked as catalog additions.

The Program Learning Outcomes list prints five lines, but the 4th and 5th lines repeat the 1st and 2nd word for word; each distinct outcome is recorded once. A reviewer may want to confirm this duplication is a page artifact.

The block header prints '0' in the units column beside 'Core Courses-54 hours'. The courses each list 9 hours, and the program total is printed as 54, so the block's stated total is recorded as 54 hours from the heading text.

The text says students completing the courses with a grade of 'P' will be awarded a 'Certificate of Completion', while the heading names a 'Certificate of Competency'. This inconsistency is in the source.
The source URL references summer-2022, but the page is within the 2026-2027 catalog.
